record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: The continuing spread of partially artemisinin-resistant Plasmodium falciparum in Africa is a health challenge that requires urgent attention. The World Health Organization has recommended multiple first-line therapies (MFT) as a response strategy. Implementing a response is critical for Uganda where four artemisinin resistance mutations are at local allele frequencies >0.20 and partner-drug efficacy may be at risk. … Out of scope: Malaria-treatment policy simulation.
record.title: Slowing the spread of treatment failure to artemisinin-based combination therapies in Uganda
